published_prior_art.cite: CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identifies the latent signal and errors, not an outcome-weighted signed channel or causal ratio.
CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 covers blind repeated-measurement signal/error identification; HuangZhang2023 covers a known-error ADRF, not their joint blind signed-channel target.
KatoSasakiUra2021 supplies density confidence-set inversion, while CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 supplies density-risk rates; neither states this coupled ADRF sup-norm diameter.

KatoSasaki2019 gives a uniform EIV regression band under an invertible conventional operator, and KatoSasakiUra2021 gives a blind density band, but neither covers the stated blind open-zero ADRF band.

CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 perturbs the latent signal, and LouniciNickl2011 treats known-operator density deconvolution; neither fixes the noisy-treatment marginal while perturbing Bernoulli outcomes.
Low1997 supplies the generic coverage-to-length device, not a blind-replicate ADRF lower experiment; no inspected source subsumes the claimed fixed-marginal converse.
HuangZhang2023 identifies the known-error ADRF and its no-error reduction is the standard g-formula.

CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 adapts density estimation to signal-tail regularity, while Low1997 concerns general honest-adaptation obstructions; neither gives this blind operator-strength ADRF-band frontier.

soundness_flags.label: target_estimand; thm:joint-analytic-identification; tldr
soundness_flags.one_line: Continuous representatives make q_x/f_x an observed-law version, but the assumptions impose no continuity/version condition on a↦E[Y(a)|X=x], so they do not justify its asserted pointwise equality to E[Y(a)] rather than only almost-everywhere equality.

source_verification_receipts.version: Electronic Journal of Statistics 19(2), 2025, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The journal article studies two independently corrupted repeated measurements, establishes identifiability without noise assumptions beyond coordinate independence, gives density-estimation rates, and states compact-support minimax optimality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Introduction pp. corresponding to online lines 115-117 and 128-137; Theorem 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs a latent-density confidence band from slacked linear complex Kotlarski moments, gives uniform asymptotic size control and fixed-alternative consistency, and does not require completeness.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometrics 213(2), 2019, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops multiplier-bootstrap uniform confidence bands for nonparametric EIV regression with unknown error distribution using validation data or repeated measurements.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section 2, equation (1), Assumption 1, and equation (2)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies and estimates an ADRF for a continuous treatment measured with classical error, takes the error characteristic function as known in its main model, and provides pointwise inference.
The paper studies known-operator density deconvolution, proves sup-norm upper and minimax lower bounds over smoothness classes, and discusses global density confidence bands.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 25(6), 1997, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives an expected-confidence-interval-length inequality under uniform coverage and derives consequences for honest adaptation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a primitive potential-response version condition: for each stratum, a↦E[Y(a)|X=x] has a continuous version on I and agrees almost everywhere with q_x/f_x; then use continuity to promote the g-formula equality to every target dose.

After repairing the causal target, isolate a scalar fixed-f, fixed-error submodel and prove the exact low-frequency image bound for the mollified Legendre perturbation before developing the full band proof; this directly tests the claimed m_n^(1/2-beta) modulus.

Turn the spectral-adaptation question into a sharper follow-on by deriving an explicit candidate testing distance for two specified polynomial envelopes and comparing it with the fixed-class width, rather than leaving the frontier entirely implicit.

recommended_next_step: Revise the pointwise causal estimand with a stated potential-response continuity/version condition, then advance the repaired field-tier kernel to Stage 0 with the fixed-marginal hard-family modulus as the first kill test.
